body:
Independent acceptance review — round 1 — PR #175: CHANGES REQUIRED (not CLEAN).

Reviewed published HEAD `7d4d9bf7181d213a0f233fca33f6b7cefa20d10b` against freshly fetched latest `origin/main=fdf52677be7ef22f8e31001031a26da61f4efdb3`. Detached review checkout: `/Users/jappy/.t3/worktrees/bobs-factory/taskbot-138-review-r1`. PR is OPEN/non-draft; no PR discussion/reviews existed when read. Read live #138/#135 and final implementation handoff2115, actual AGENTS→CLAUDE, package instructions, product contracts, distribution guidance and canonical verification/F1 policies. Applied code-review skill with separate Standards and Spec helpers. Its optional tracker-instructions file is absent; live Taskbot and supplied authoritative specification provided the tracker context.

## Standards

NOT CLEAN: one confirmed P2 data-safety contract breach, R1 below. It contradicts the documented plain JSON/no-accessor preflight contract at `docs/factory/foreach.md:95`. No additional consequential standards breach or Fowler-smell finding. Naming, Node24/Bun boundary, private packages, native credential ownership, attribution, full prompt expectation, changelog linkage and preserved fixture assertions conform. R2 is the separate Spec-axis finding, not an additional Standards count.

## Spec

CHANGES REQUIRED: two confirmed P2 findings, R1 and R2. Existing tests and authenticated evidence otherwise cover the ticket proportionately. No missing restarted-EdgeWorker experiment, abrupt-kill-at-every-instruction guarantee, paid model experiment, deployment or future #147 policy is invented as an acceptance condition.

### R1 — P2 / medium — preflight invokes untrusted accessors and accepts malformed non-JSON sources

Location: [Foreach.ts:174](https://github.com/jappyjan/bobs-factory/blob/7d4d9bf7181d213a0f233fca33f6b7cefa20d10b/packages/edge-worker/src/factory/Foreach.ts#L174), especially the original-object `JSON.stringify` at line192; settings/source descriptor checks at lines203–220.

Requirement: descriptor-first bounded safe-data preflight before parsers/getters; plain JSON, no arbitrary prototypes, accessors or sparse arrays.

Confirmed direct Node24.21.0 source probe:
```js
let calls = 0;
const item = Object.defineProperty({id: "a"}, "toJSON", {
  get() { calls++; return () => ({id: "changed"}); }
});
prepareForeach({items: {values: [item]}}, {outputs: {}});
```
This succeeds and calls the hidden getter TWICE. The output-path variant calls it once. Validation uses enumerable `Object.keys`, so the hidden descriptor is skipped before stringification invokes it. `items=Object.create({get values(){calls++; return [{id:"a"}]}})` is likewise accepted and invokes the inherited getter once before Zod completes. Also, `const a=new Array(1); a.foo={id:"a"}` is accepted as a one-item snapshot with no index0: key-count equality is not an array-density check.

Consequence: input code runs during a boundary advertised as data-only, before dispatch; arbitrary serialization hooks bypass the bounded traversal, and malformed collections can become accepted snapshots.

Expected narrow fix: establish plain prototypes and inspect complete relevant descriptors before parsing/stringifying; validate/serialize a sanitized data representation without invoking input hooks; require each array index and reject extra non-index properties. Add regressions asserting zero getter calls and rejection for these cases. Preserve current valid JSON/key/limit behavior.

Probe and output retained outside source: `/tmp/taskbot138-review-r1-safe-data.mjs`, `/tmp/taskbot138-review-r1-safe-data.log`.

### R2 — P2 / medium — inherited outputs become unearned item/Call results

Locations: [WorkflowRuntime.ts:5191](https://github.com/jappyjan/bobs-factory/blob/7d4d9bf7181d213a0f233fca33f6b7cefa20d10b/packages/edge-worker/src/factory/WorkflowRuntime.ts#L5191) and mapped Call projection at [line2593](https://github.com/jappyjan/bobs-factory/blob/7d4d9bf7181d213a0f233fca33f6b7cefa20d10b/packages/edge-worker/src/factory/WorkflowRuntime.ts#L2593).

Requirement: keyed results/history preserve exact producer/item/frame identity; independent children do not leak parent/sibling outputs; later Check consumes actual keyed results.

Confirmed in ordinary WorkflowRuntime execution with valid definitions and scripted hooks:
1. Outer agent `skipped` returns `{approved:true,authority:"outer-only"}`.
2. For each item `a` has body `route(next:"end")`, then agent `skipped`.
3. Calls/history contain only outer `skipped` and `each/a/route`; no `each/a/skipped`.
4. Nonetheless `each.results.a.skipped` contains the outer approval.
5. A downstream Check of `/inputs/batch/results/a/skipped/approved` returns `{passed:true,childApproved:true}`.

A separate mapped Call reproduces the same defect: calls are `skipped, call/route`, but `call.outputs.skipped` contains the outer-only approval and the downstream Check passes. Body IDs are valid lexical IDs; no prohibited global-ID collision was required.

Cause: child output maps begin with inherited input context, and the new result projections use only `Object.hasOwn(..., bodyStep.id)` as proof of child production.

Expected narrow fix: retain inherited read context, but project outputs using actual production membership/receipts in the exact item or Call frame. Persist that ownership through restart and preserve legacy shared/unmapped Call behavior. Cover both inline iteration and mapped Call collisions plus downstream Check behavior.

Reproducible harness: `/tmp/taskbot138-review-r1-probes.mjs` (SHA256 `81c8cfce3610134f091c1f9779d84d1956dc07d80e85cdddaa3f2126ecfcec63`).
Output: `/tmp/taskbot138-review-r1-probes-check.log` (SHA256 `d0eae15355c5a696624fcaa3249fd5d52456a0ebaa30c712af8e1926658ff5a4`).

Native continuation is retained logical work, not a claim of zero new native turns. |

## Checks run independently

Node24.21.0; frozen-lockfile dependency setup with scripts disabled. Source was never changed. To avoid a duplicate broad build, generated package dist files were copied into this review checkout from the retained, hash-verified production-input build; relevant source imports were compiled by Vitest.

- Direct source safe-data probe and ordinary compiled-runtime inline/mapped Call/downstream Check probes confirmed R1/R2. No provider calls.
- Exact commit/tree/allowlist inspection, dependency/license diff, prompt-change comparison, clean tracked/index checks and `git diff --check`.

Reused local gates: build9b79 PASS; clean f4fe typecheck/lint PASS (34existing warnings), packages **4013pass/2skip**, apps **312pass/1skip**, scripts **179pass**, audit **0advisories**. Counts agree with full logs. First package failure remains separately retained: ENOTEMPTY in afterEach after ownership assertions, explained by live reloaded/captured retention owners. The fixture diff stops both retention owners/drains both runtimes; no product change or assertion weakening, and independent rerun includes all59 ownership cases.

Mocked actual EdgeWorker/CLI F1: six scenarios,18controlled provider starts/16successful mock sessions, four downstream Checks,28activities/22comments, actual capacity2,0paid. These were authenticated, not rerun or relabeled final-head executions. F1 does not restart EdgeWorker; runtime tests cover graceful mid-item persistence/save barrier; native restart is settled only. No arbitrary exactly-once external effect, real model quality/provider authentication or other-target claim.

Final review worktree HEAD remains exact7d4; tracked files and index are clean; one untracked generated `.husky/_/` directory exists. Parent/implementation/prior worktrees were not modified. No source fixes, push, merge, status/deployment/active-run edits or later-ticket implementation.

body:

author: Taskbot #138 implementation
body:
Acceptance round 1 response, work resumed on retained isolated taskbot/138-foreach checkout at7d4d9bf7; fresh origin/main still fdf52677. Independently reproduced BOTH findings before edits using the exact reviewer probes: /tmp/taskbot138-r2-reproduce-safety.log confirms hidden getter2/1 calls, inherited getter1 and sparse+extra accepted; /tmp/taskbot138-r2-reproduce-ownership.log confirms inline and mappedCall skipped child absent from calls/history but inherited approval published and downstream Check true. Original review/probes/reports remain preserved.

R1 root cause: enumerable-key traversal and original-object stringify miss hidden descriptors/hooks; Zod reaches inherited source properties; key count is not array density. Repair uses exact plain/null prototypes, complete own descriptors, dense numeric array indices/no extras and a sanitized hook-free representation before parser/stringify. Zero-hook regressions cover direct settings and workflow nested source boundaries; valid JSON/defaults/keys/limits stay supported.

R2 root cause: own keys in cloned read context were treated as produced values. Repair separates persistent exact-frame result receipts from inherited READ outputs. New item/mappedCall frames record accepted own step results; projection uses those receipts, not context property presence. Generic Parallel inside these new scopes also projects actual branch results; outside legacy Parallel/shared/unmappedCall shapes remain unchanged, and authenticated explicit review reuse retains its existing path. Older unfinished frames may recover membership only from visited local steps plus exact qualified original immutable history/item identity, never mutable inherited names or invented calls. Dedicated collision/skipped-branch/downstreamCheck/nesting/reload regressions are being added. No generic stale-input exemption, convergence policy, active-run edit or later-ticket expansion.

One integration owner handles runtime; disjoint helpers own R1 sanitizer/tests, new ownership regressions and a new focused EdgeWorker/CLI F1 driver. Focused mechanisms will stabilize before a new combined-source freeze, required gates, fresh mocked F1 and compiled-product smoke. Previous source-specific runtime gates remain historical. Parent retains status, CI watch, fresh independent re-review and merge.
